# Connected shutdown owner components

Run exact Node26.13.0 with --expose-internals and frontend.cjs native|after REPO
through scripts/dev-shell.sh. Before additionally requires the sealed sibling
before/bootstrap and baseline-core.js layout. It consumes actual generated
Socket/stream/bootstrap algorithms over genuine native TCP, ShutdownWrap,
StreamBase/write/close, UV error, AsyncHook/fatal and VM dependencies. The new
production guest JSAPI is not executed by this native backend fixture.

Compile shutdown-control.cc with declared c++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror

production portable Owner/Shutdown/Write headers, native TCP sockets/queues/
POSIX errors, original retained backing, real allocation failure and native
memory ledger. No standalone copy of the owning algorithms is substituted.

Read the sealed report before counting outcomes. Initial fixture SIGPIPE,
missing final observations despite exit0, initial wrong private close-phase
source policy and another real owner's global-hook count are preserved as
nonpasses/review corrections. Final controls scope hooks to actual parent
identity and await actual first close; no second already-completed wrapper
